name: shibumi-beach-caddy
description: Phase 2 of the Shibumi-adapters program: ONE combined caddy that mounts to the Shibumi beach chair (via the Phase-1 capture socket) and holds a phone, a Kindle, and a Yeti bottle together, ergonomically. Prefer UNIBODY (single print, capture socket integrated). Parameterized PER PERSON so a second owner's caddy (Hana) is a dimension swap, not a redesign. v0 = architecture/massing stage: packaging + structural reasoning locked, geometry pending open decisions (Yeti diameter, chair load path, final layout).
requiresId_note: Utility part; 'ergonomic' handled as functional layout, not aesthetic motif. Revisit if Matt wants styling.
material_note: PLA for fit/massing prototypes. Final beach part PETG or ASA (UV + hot-trunk + load). Geometry kept material-agnostic.

program.mount_interface: socket backing face, 28.2 x 40.1 mm, r3.0, in the -Z plane; gap-independent so caddy design is NOT blocked by the pending A/B/C fit-test
program.recommended_coupling: UNIBODY — integrate the capture socket into the caddy; no separable joint. See ARCHITECTURE.md for why (removes the weakest link under a full-bottle moment).

phone.note: iPhone IN CASE. Caliper maxed on H -> ~156 is a FLOOR, likely slightly more. t=15 includes camera bump.

kindle.note: Caliper maxed on H -> ~176 is a FLOOR.

bottle.note: CONFIRMED by Matt (WM#592, 2026-07-25): the 96mm is the DIAMETER (~36oz-class Yeti). Bottle oz still assumed ~36 for mass estimate.

hana.note: Hana gets her OWN caddy with her devices' dims. Design stays parameterized so this is a re-slice, not a re-model.

design_margins.note: Applied to a person's raw dims to get modeled interior envelopes.
design_margins.tall_dim_hold_fraction: cradle holds a lower portion; item protrudes for grab. Add extra height margin since tall dims are caliper-maxed floors.

loadCase.note: PRELIMINARY — refine once geometry + chair load path are known. Governs requiresStrainAnalysis=true.
loadCase.bottle_mass_note: bottle ~0.45kg + up to ~1L water; use 1.2-1.5kg. Confirm bottle size (26/36/46oz) with Matt.
loadCase.lever_arm_concern: all mass cantilevers off a ~28x40mm cleat socket. Overturning moment ~1.5-2 N*m estimated. MITIGATION: caddy likely must BEAR on the chair frame; heavy bottle kept nearest the mount + low. Chair geometry REQUIRED to finalize.

open_items: MOUNT/LOAD-PATH ONLY (does NOT block the body): chair geometry around the cleat (photos) + whether the caddy can rest against the chair frame. Determines if a single cleat mount is structurally sufficient.
MOUNT ONLY: Phase-1 A/B/C fit-test result -> sets the integrated capture socket's rail_height. Socket is modeled as a parametric TBD placeholder until then.
Bottle oz refinement (assumed ~36oz for mass; confirm).
RESOLVED 2026-07-25: Yeti Ø96 = diameter (WM#592); unibody + depth-stack layout confirmed (WM#585/592).
